'''Bith''' were a peaceful, highly evolved [[craniopod]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. Fully adapted to a civilized, high-technology lifestyle, Bith were found [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] at all levels of society, most notably as [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], intellectuals, consultants, and [[Musician/Legends|musicians]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:DoikkNats-TVD.jpg|160px|thumb|180px|left|[[Doikk Na'ts/Legends|Doikk Na'ts]], a Bith musician]]

Bith were [[craniopod]]s<ref name="BDB">{{DB|species|bith|Bith}}</ref> with pale pink, red, yellow, or (rarely) green skin, large heads, large lidless eyes, toeless feet, and long fingers with large finger pads and crosshatched fingerprints. Their thumb and small finger were both fully opposable.<ref name="GG4" /> The Bith's internal systems were different from most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], as the Bith had only one [[Lung/Legends|lung]], and exhaled through their skin.<ref name="BDB" /> Bith also lacked a proper [[Nose/Legends|nose]], instead having highly sensitive olfactory organs hidden in the skin flaps of their cheeks.<ref name="GG4" />

The other Bith senses were also acute. Bith could sense the tonal qualities of sound as well as other races sensed [[Color/Legends|colors]].<ref name="We Don't Do Weddings: The Band's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=We Don't Do Weddings: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Their eyes, as big as a [[Menahuun]]'s,<ref name="Reckonings">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> were able to focus to 0.07 on the [[Gandok Scale]],<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> and they could see microscopic details of nearby objects, but were extremely nearsighted as a result. An interesting side effect of their incredible sensors was the effect of [[Sonic grenade/Legends|sonic grenades]], or ''screamers'', on them. It was described as causing their heads to explode.<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Similarly, Bith had high manual dexterity, which helped them manipulate fine tools, though their prowess with gross motor skills was only average.<ref name="GG4" />

Bith had evolved past the need for sleep. Instead, they would slip into a light [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] trance, which allowed them to get as much rest in four hours as other species could get in eight. During this trance, Bith were still almost fully aware of their surroundings.<ref name="UAA" />

A Bith's reproductive organs atrophied over time, as did the portions of their brain governing such impulses. As such, Bith were unable to reproduce naturally, instead relying on artificial conception and gestation. Mates brought genetic material to a [[Computer Mating Service]] for analysis against prospective mates. Bith children were created from genetic material from two parents, which was combined, fertilized, and incubated for a year.<ref name="GG4" />

==History==
Bith were one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most ancient civilizations, with a history going back millions of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This antiquity garnered respect in certain quarters, such as among the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]], who gave them more respect than other, "younger" species.<ref name="GE">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref> Their society was highly regimented, with everything from mate selection to political leadership controlled by sophisticated computer programs.<ref name="GG4" />

Made easily accessible to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]] with the blazing of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], the Bith were moving around the galaxy by the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], as their homeworld was in a part of space greatly explored by the Republic at that time. Considered part of the civilized galaxy by the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the Bith homeworld was located in space controlled by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the Republic recovered following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the Bith became a vocal voice in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], gaining a seat in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="UAA" />

[[File:Bith_band_TCWf.png|thumb|left|250px|A Bith [[Band/Legends|band]] in [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] lair on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]

Circa [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species real-world book">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> the Bith city-states of [[Nozho/Legends|Nozho]] and [[Weogar/Legends|Weogar]] engaged in a massive civil war using biological weapons over patent rights to a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. The aftermath of the [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|Nozho–Weogar War]] destroyed Clak'dor VII's ecosystem and crippled the Bith industrial capacity, forcing the Bith to retreat to sealed cities and rely on imported goods and machinery to keep their society functioning.<ref name="GG4" /> The [[Y'bith/Legends|Y'bith]], a subspecies of Bith, were descended from Bith whose genetic code was altered in the aftermath of a biological attack on Nozho. These "ghost Bith" resettled on [[Clak'dor IV]] and developed their own society, somewhat estranged from the Bith mainstream.<ref name="YDB" />

The war also brought out a strong pacifistic streak in Bith culture, electing vocal Senate members who pushed for galactic disarmament.<ref name="GG4" /> While they attempted to remain neutral during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] they were eventually coerced into supporting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] against the Republic by Confederate leader [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="BDB" /> Both the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made the Bith uneasy about conditions in the rest of the galaxy, with most Bith choosing to wait out the dark times within Clak'dor VII's sealed cities.<ref name="UAA" /> After the Clone Wars, the Bith did not resist the Empire, instead putting their technical expertise at the service of the Imperial war machine.<ref name="GG4" /> The Bith were horrified by the Empire, however, and were among the first species to be liberated from the [[Eriadu Authority]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Bith did not emerge fully from their isolation until [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], shortly after the [[Hapan]]s rejoined the Galactic community.<ref name="UAA" /> A Republic stronghold during the [[Thrawn campaign]], the Bith homeworld would go on to avoid invasion by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Bith in the galaxy==
[[File:BithBand.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Bith band at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] fanfaring [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]]]]
A species of pacifists following the devastation of their homeworld during the Nozho–Weogar War, many Bith worked as [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], as data analysts, or in other intellectual professions. Others used their intelligence, natural technical skills, and dexterity to work in the criminal underworld.<ref name="GG4" /> Many Bith worked as [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] staff, since [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in Bith society held a position equivalent in many ways to [[Priest/Legends|priests]] in other cultures.<ref name="KOTORII" /> The [[Intelligence Quartermaster]] for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] was a Bith stationed on the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Fleet]].<ref name="SWTOR IF">{{TORcite|On the Imperial Fleet}}</ref> At the same time, [[Unaw Aharo]] was a Bith [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during escalating war between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR AotFR">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref> Their hearing also made Bith such as [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]], the house band in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] circa [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], excellent musicians.<ref name="ANH" />

Bith had a longstanding tradition of sending their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] members to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Aside from Jedi Aharo during the Cold War, [[Ph'ton]] served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the Clone Wars and a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="GG">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref> Many other Bith had served the Order as [[Jedi Consular]]s over the years; some of them were rumored to have survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] by hiding on their homeworld.<ref name="UAA" />

Not all Force-sensitive Bith served the Jedi, however. [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Rugess Nome]] was taken as a member of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and eventually named Darth Tenebrous. In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]],<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> while Tenebrous and his apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], were stationed on the planet [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], Plagueis killed the Bith Sith Lord, stating that he planned to overthrow the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], establishing a new order of his own, that would stay for a thousand years under his control.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bith species was originally meant to be called the "Sicmoo,"<ref name="Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> a phonetic anagram of "music."

[[Doug Beswick]] built the Bith costumes for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']].<ref name="BDB" />
